title: LearnUP Pagination Metadata Schema
description: Offset/page-based pagination metadata returned alongside list data collections.

size.description: Number of elements requested per page.

totalElements.description: Total number of items matching the query criteria across all pages.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages calculated from totalElements and size.

hasNext.description: True if there is a subsequent page available.

hasPrevious.description: True if there is a preceding page available.
